title: Do not mistake nearness for taste
summary: The Lord is already within the body-fortress, but stubbornness cannot taste that nearness until mercy opens the Shabad on the tongue.
takeaway: Ask the Shabad to sweeten what nearness alone has not changed.
lifeApplication: When sacred practice feels flat, stop measuring your feeling and ask for the Guru's Word to soften the stubborn place in you.

source.shortMeaning: Mercy turns the Lord's nearness from an idea into tasted sweetness.
source.lifeApplication: Ask the Guru's Shabad to soften the place that has been close to truth but slow to taste it.

evidence.coreClaim: Mercy turns the Lord's nearness from an idea into tasted sweetness.
evidence.turn: The body-fortress already holds the Lord; the hard heart needs mercy and Shabad before nearness becomes sweet.
evidence.practicalImplication: When sacred practice feels flat, stop measuring your feeling and ask for the Guru's Word to soften the stubborn place in you.
